statement: The Ridge model produced a complete descending E1 ranking of all 904 candidate lines (predicted GRWT100 1.50-3.66 g). E1 top-18 lines measured mean 3.67 g vs stratified-control mean 2.22 g, and Spearman(E1 prediction, E3 measured) ~ +0.66 over 24 phenotyped lines, so the model ranking is informative and high-E1 lines are enriched for high measured 100-grain weight.
limits: E1 predictions are model outputs, not measured phenotypes

statement: The E1 ranking degrades sharply beyond rank ~18: E1 ranks 19-24 measured 2.0-3.3 g (including IRIS_313.12049=2.0 and IRIS_313.10448=2.1), so top-quartile membership must be validated with real measurements rather than assumed from E1 alone.

Final top-10 (measured GRWT100 3.4-5.0 g) are all above the bracketed ~2.6-2.9 g 75th-percentile boundary of the candidate pool, so all 10 are likely in the high-grain-weight quartile. The final ranking is ordered by measured value, with E1 prediction as tie-breaker (IRIS_313.12228>IRIS_313.12129 at 3.8 g; IRIS_313.11094>IRIS_313.10679 at 3.6 g; IRIS_313.12262>IRIS_313.10653>IRIS_313.10660 at 3.4 g).
limits: 75th-percentile boundary is bracketed, not directly measured

statement: Limitations: only 30 of 904 candidates were phenotyped (oracle budget exhausted), so lines with E1 rank >=24 were not measured and could exceed the cutoff; measurements are single-environment, one per line, rounded to 0.1 g; E1 predictions must never be read as measured phenotypes.
